Where to vote and questions: your county auditor's office.
Independent voter info, not an official government post.

item.caption:
What is a retention election? If a judge on your Nov 3 ballot has no opponent, this is probably why. 🗳️

In a retention election, a sitting judge is listed alone and voters choose "yes" or "no" on whether they stay for another term. In most states a majority "yes" keeps the seat; some states set a higher threshold. If a judge isn't retained, the seat is filled through the state's vacancy process.

Before you vote, check your sample ballot, any official judicial performance evaluation, bar association reviews, and the judge's own opinions.

Look up a judge free at judgelens.app (link in bio).

Legal information, not legal advice.

#RetentionElection #JudgesOnTheBallot #ElectionDay #CourtRecords #JudgeLens

item.caption:
I VOTED! And yes, I took the picture to prove it!

Early voting? DONE!

As someone who came to this country as an immigrant, built a life here, and eventually became a U.S. citizen, voting will never feel like just another errand.

Especially today, when so many immigrant families are facing uncertainty and fear.

Democracy isn’t something we get to take for granted. It’s something we have to keep showing up for.

I’ve spent my career talking about leadership and creating change.

But leadership isn’t just what we say on a stage.

It’s what we do when nobody’s watching.

Midterms are just days away. Get informed. Show up. Make your voice heard!

Your voice matters. Your vote matters.

P.S. Can we agree that the “I VOTED” sticker is one of the best accessories of the season?

#IVoted #Midterms2026 #Leadership #Democracy
